note: What a server sends a client watching a match to set when a camp is next due. The header carries zero.

fields.name: timer
fields.note: Which camp's timer, by a number a name gives.

fields.name: expires
fields.note: When it is due, in match seconds.

revisions.note: A client takes it whether it watches the match or plays it, and shows nothing of it on the match screen.
